svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Tambourine face - OPTIONAL ALTERNATIVE: same artwork uniformly scaled to 93.3% so all elements sit inside the 5 mm safe area (no distortion, no redesign)
svg.desc: Optional. Use only if the supplier requires the 5 mm safe area. Primary files in the parent folder reproduce the reference composition at 100%. | FOIL_GOLD layer = spot colour for metallic foil (display colour #A37A4E). FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.
